summary: Red Robin Gourmet Burgers (issuer) filed an 8-K reporting two asset sale agreements. Through wholly owned subsidiary RRI, it agreed to sell 69 company-owned restaurants to Op Burgers, LLC for $62.5M cash and 17 restaurants to Kuber entities for $10.0M cash, totaling $72.5M. The transactions convert company-owned units into franchised locations via long-term franchise agreements at close. Closings are targeted for July 17 and August 28, 2026, respectively, subject to landlord, liquor license, and lender consents. The moves reduce capital intensity and improve franchisee mix. Risk-arb: watch for consent delays; both buyers are franchise operators.
